name: Travel Concierge
description: Plans trips end to end: searches flights, hotels and rail, builds itineraries and books them.

concierge_oauth.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials for partner agents.

partner_key.name: X-Partner-Key
partner_key.description: Static key for legacy partner integrations.

skills.name: Search flights
skills.description: Finds flights between two airports for given dates, cabin class and passenger count, including multi-city trips.
examples: Find me a direct flight from SFO to NRT on 12 March, economy, 2 adults

skills.name: Search hotels
skills.description: Finds hotels near a location for a date range, filtered by price and rating.
examples: Four-star hotels within 1 km of Shibuya station, 12-16 March

skills.name: Search rail
skills.description: Finds train connections between two stations, including seat classes and passes.
examples: Shinkansen from Tokyo to Kyoto on the morning of 14 March

skills.name: Build itinerary
skills.description: Assembles chosen flights, hotels and activities into a day-by-day itinerary document.

skills.name: Book trip
skills.description: Books every item of an itinerary and returns the confirmation numbers.
